test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'UKSH' is written as '8TL21'. How will 'GAIN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **First and last letters → Position value** according to the English alphabetic series is written diagonally.
 
• Second and third letters → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• 'UKSH' is written as '8TL21'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f0c7078d3e6c3bf8ae356245d55fb49681bf78b2f629f6e34832cd05736d9e.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'GAIN' will be written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60979c0a908523a45f56048a9d40a2b839599d209eb047b88dd715d0e631606e.png] 

​Hence, "ONSLBK" is the correct answer.

8c:T9d
